decisions.reason: As a small accessory with lower likely sunk costs, less strategic importance, and only limited public commitment, this is the easiest product to discontinue once its momentum appears to have faded.

A box car trailer series sits at the core of the firm's trailer business and was promoted on the home page, so management would be inclined to continue it and justify the investment despite mixed later signals.

The car transporter trailer is still closely related to the firm's capabilities and target users, and management can plausibly treat weaker traction as temporary while staying committed to a specialized growth product.

The low-bed trailer series is a central transport product with visible public backing on the home page, making escalation of commitment likely and withdrawal harder to justify internally and externally.
The high trailer cover series complements the firm's existing trailer range, supports adaptation to customer needs, and had strong website visibility, all of which favor persistence.

Even with possible overlap inside the range, another box car trailer series reflects a public and strategically central commitment to the firm's main business, so management would tend to retain it rather than concede failure.
